- **Anthracnose**: Dark brown/black lesions on pods/stems — no match
- **Charcoal_Rot**: Gray charcoal appearance from microsclerotia on lower stem/roots — no match
- **Diaporthe**: Brown cankers with black specks in linear rows — no match
- **Sudden_death_syndrome**: Leaf chlorosis with green veins, root discoloration — no match

The test image shows the hallmark of White Mold: grayish-white cottony mycelial growth at a stem node, with surrounding yellowed dying leaves — consistent with Sclerotinia stem rot.
